PluginData.Author: rosudrag
PluginData.Tooltip: Spreads bulk entity creation across frames to remove multiplayer streaming freezes
PluginData.Description:
Phyzix - Space Engineers Entity Streaming Optimizer
Removes the multi-second freezes caused by a large batch of entities being added to the scene in one frame - entering a new sector, an MES encounter spawning, an asteroid field streaming in.
HOW IT WORKS
The game drains its async entity-creation queue with an unbounded loop in MyEntities.UpdateAfterSimulation. Each iteration runs MyEntities.Add and OnAddedToScene: render object alloc, physics registration, hierarchy update. A whole sector finishing in one tick lands in one frame.
Phyzix bounds that loop with a per-frame budget - a count cap and a wall-clock cap. The rest is consumed on later frames. Nothing is dropped, and the budget always admits at least one entity per frame, so a backlog can never stall.
Network-streamed asteroids skip that queue, so Phyzix captures MyVoxelReplicable.OnLoad and replays it under the same budget on a later frame - the mechanism the replication layer already uses for grids.
SETTINGS
- Max entity adds per frame (default 8) - Frame budget in milliseconds (default 3) - Defer asteroid loads (default on) - Max deferred asteroid loads (default 64) - past this cap loads run immediately, so extreme storms degrade to vanilla instead of growing memory - Optional per-second counters in the game log - Optional in-game chat narration of what the plugin is doing (off by default)
SCOPE
Multiplayer only - the patched loop is guarded by a multiplayer check and voxel replication is network-only, so the plugin is a no-op offline. No budget while a session is still loading.
Client-side only. Works on any server.
Report bugs: https://github.com/rosudrag/se-phyzix/issues
